summary: Full backend + frontend testing for iter_11 (admin CS chat-record browser, agent workbench sound/title, FAQ unread_agent inc, status-log date-range, import_from_live ONLY_CS syntax). Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_cs_admin_chat_logs.py (3.5s on preview URL). Verified: GET /api/admin/cs/sessions requires admin JWT (401 raw, 403 with agent token); returns {sessions,total,page,size} shape; each row has agent_name/msg_total/msg_visitor/last_message_at; agent_id filter works; URL-encoded Chinese q (越南) not blocked by ingress and returns valid shape; start=not-a-date -> 400; date range 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 works; pagination size=2 page=1 vs page=2 returns disjoint id sets. GET /api/admin/cs/sessions/{id}/messages: unknown id 404; valid returns {session,agent,messages} with messages sorted asc by created_at. POST /api/cs/{sid}/faq: created session via /cs/start (with session_id in body), confirmed via /cs/agent/sessions that unread_agent >= before+1 after FAQ click. GET /api/cs/agent/status-log?start=2026-10-01&end=2026-10-21 returns {days:[]} (future range correctly empty); start=bad -> 400; GET /api/admin/cs/status-log with range+agent_id returns {days,online_now}. import_from_live.py py_compile OK and contains 'ONLY_CS' token. Frontend /cs (agent01/Pass@123): cs-wb-sound-btn toggles localStorage hy_cs_agent_sound between '1' and '0', persisted across full reload; with sound ON, sent a visitor message via /api/cs/start + /api/cs/{sid}/message and document.title became '(4) 新消息 · 客服工作台' within ~2s poll cycle. Frontend /admin (admin/Heying@2026) -> SECOND '在线客服' tab: cs-chat-logs renders, cs-chat-total='共 41 个会话', 30 rows (default size), filter cs-chat-q='越南' + cs-chat-query narrows to '共 2 个会话'; clicking cs-chat-view-<id> opens cs-chat-viewer portal modal, cs-chat-viewer-messages contains '· 欢迎语' label and visitor-side bubble, cs-chat-viewer-close closes it; cs-chat-prev/next pagination controls present (41>30). cs-status-log date filters (cs-status-start/end/agent) all present; cs-status-days-30 preset sets start=2026-09-23 end=2026-10-22 correctly. Regression /chat (390px): 4 FAQ buttons render, first FAQ click adds Q+A bubbles, text send shows 'regression hello' bubble. Home / renders '合赢项目社 | 聚力项目，合作共赢'. Agent01 brought back ONLINE at end via /api/cs/agent/status.
action_items: Pre-existing (from iter_9/10, still present): React 'Encountered two children with the same key cc61c833-24f8-4036-80d7-9db405ad4386' warning fires repeatedly in /cs CSWorkbench on each poll tick. Not visually broken but noisy. Suggested fix: dedupe sessions/messages by id (`Array.from(new Map(items.map(x=>[x.id,x])).values())`) before setState in loadSessions/loadMessages polling branches.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_cs_sessions correctly projects {_id:0} and attaches agent_name/msg_total/msg_visitor via a single aggregation on cs_messages — no N+1. Falls back to '（已删除坐席）' when agent missing. Date range uses CN_TZ -> UTC conversion with [start_day, end_day+1) half-open on last_message_at ISO strings. Note: comparing ISO strings relies on consistent ISO format (all writes use .isoformat() on UTC datetimes, so OK).
admin_cs_session_messages projects {_id:0, created_at_dt:0} and sorts by created_at ASC — correct for chat replay. 404 on unknown session id.
cs_visitor_faq increments unread_agent by 1 (single $inc) alongside last_message_at — correct and matches /message endpoint. Verified via /cs/agent/sessions.
parse_cn_date raises HTTPException(400) on ValueError, re-used by both admin and agent status-log + sessions endpoints — consistent error contract.
CSChatLogs.jsx uses createPortal(..., document.body) with a note explaining that backdrop-filter on parent would break fixed positioning — nice defensive comment.

CSWorkbench playAlert uses WebAudio OscillatorNode (dual-tone, no asset) — safe fallback if browser blocks autoplay (wrapped in try). document.title update uses unread aggregate across sessions; soundRef guards against stale closure in polling interval.
Minor: /api/admin/cs/sessions accepts page without upper bound on skip — large page numbers will just return empty array (no error), acceptable.
No ObjectId leakage; all find/aggregate project _id:0.
